snippet.title: Dog in the Machine - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4613180/Dog_in_the_Machine/
Train an AutoDog to escape a dystopian mecha-city in this tactical roguelite. Craft powerful modular attacks, plan every move with stress-free real-time previews, and unleash devastating chain reactions to outsmart hordes of killjoy robots!
